column1: # Recipe-ownership policy guards (2026-11-10): lines that only assert AGENTS.md's boundary (recipes are authored,
# stored and executed in the donor; this repository receives postimages and data-only receipts). They name the
# donor without needing it to build, test, gate or release, so check_standalone.py reports them as P_POLICY. A
# line stops being policy when it is edited, or when its file fetches, checks out or builds from the donor or
# holds any other counted donor reference.
